accuracy: One locked D ep2 TEST; reuse sealed R4/M20/V predictions. Report sizes, joint migrations, RIoU/AP75, real/sim/videos and accurate M edges. No selection or optimizer.
efficiency: Only D full chain rerun: decoded BGR CPU image -> preprocess/H2D -> R4 native head/NMS -> single shared ROI -> M20 -> D -> CPU original OBB. Warmup50 and1440x3; output verification outside timers; report mean/P50/P95/FPS, four time windows, parameters and GPU allocated/reserved and driver samples.
historical_efficiency: Original M/V measurements are reused as historical context, not a new same-batch incremental-cost or speedup claim. No V or M-only rebenchmark.
stop: Any identity/nonfinite/replay/contended-GPU/resource/output-equivalence failure stops without retry. No epoch, threshold or model search.
download: Core JSON/CSV/MD/SHA only; weights, per-frame outputs/times and images stay on server.
